text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Registration of Dogs (Fees) Rules. Fees for dog licences.
The annual fees payable for dog licences shall be $5 in respect of every dog. Fees for replacement of dog labels and badges.
The fee to be paid to the Registering Officer for the issue of a fresh label or badge in accordance with the provisions of section 3(2) shall be $3.
